name: Dragonspine Spear
effectTemplate: Hitting an opponent with Normal and Charged Attacks has a <color=#99FFFFFF>{0}</color> chance of forming and dropping an Everfrost Icicle above them, dealing AoE DMG equal to <color=#99FFFFFF>{1}</color> of ATK.
